selection_rule: Highest mean group-aware CV PR-AUC; ties (within 0.002) broken by higher ROC-AUC then lower Brier score. The test set is never used for selection.

risk_bands.name: Moderate
risk_bands.guidance: Around or modestly above the historical rate.

risk_bands.name: High
risk_bands.guidance: Roughly twice the historical rate or more.
